name: Microsure
description: Microsure B.V. is a medical robotics company founded in 2016 in Eindhoven, Netherlands, as a spin-off from Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) and Maastricht University Medical Center+ (MUMC+). The company develops the [MUSA-3](/robot/microsure_musa_3) teleoperated robotic platform for open microsurgery and super-microsurgery.
